media.title: Henri Garat — Paramount Studios portrait
media.description: Low-resolution Paramount Studios publicity portrait of French actor and singer Henri Garat.
media.altText: Black-and-white Paramount Studios portrait of Henri Garat wearing a dark suit and patterned bow tie, with his arms folded.
media.publicCaption: Henri Garat, French actor and singer associated with Kaper’s French films and recordings.
media.publicCreditLine: Paramount Studios; reproduced via Amis et Passionnés du Père-Lachaise (APPL). Photographer and original publication unidentified.
media.rightsNote: Photographer, date, original publication and image rights holder are not identified on the source page, and APPL does not provide a reuse licence. The supplied 277 × 439 pixel copy is reproduced without enlargement solely for scholarly identification and discussion of Garat’s documented performances in Kaper-related films and recordings; it is excluded from galleries and timeline illustration.
